Name: Leelo's Flame Point Cat
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/center]


Adds a cute flame point cat to the game. This cat is based on ThaleTheGreat's cat, Zuko, pictured below. This cat is adoptable at the beginning of a new game or through Marnie later on. Hats are fully functional with this cat sprite!

[center][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/center]


Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same filepath (StardewValley\Mods), and you are all set.

This cat sprite serves as a standalone option, but it is also part of mod bundle that comes with a brown tabby cat, a tortoiseshell cat, a tuxedo cat, and an orange cow cat.. See my other mod, Leelo's Cats, to view that bundle.

You do [b]not[/b] need to start a new game. The added cat can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content[/color]


[center][b][size=4]Meet the Model[/size][/b][/center]

Zuko the flame point cat belongs to ThaleTheGreat and is one of six cats in the household. He can be naughty, like many orange cats,  but he is also very cuddly and sweet. Thanks again to ThaleTheGreat for the suggestion. Be sure to check out their mods![/center]
